operations.description: Switch the active workspace view (home/prepare/preview/workbench). Pure view state — project scope, conversation identity and slicing state are never touched.
eligibility: The target view must be one of home/prepare/preview/workbench (closed enum).
When the request pins a project/conversation scope, it must equal the currently active scope, else a typed context-changed denial.
Same callId + same args replays as a no-op; same callId + different args is refused.
exclusions: Never mutates project scope, the active conversation or the scene.
Never starts slicing/builds or sends any printer/broker/cloud traffic.

operations.description: Select an existing, visible object on the active plate through the shared scene store select(). Read-only preview is preserved: selection is only eligible on the prepare surface.

name.description: Object name that must exist in the active scene, be visible and belong to the active plate.

eligibility: The scene store must be hydrated (objects non-empty).
The name must exist, be visible (visible !== false) and belong to the active plate.
Only available on the prepare surface — preview stays read-only, home/workbench deny selection.
exclusions: No geometry mutation, no print/re-print, no printer/upload/control traffic.
Unknown names, hidden objects, cross-plate objects and non-prepare views are typed denials with zero state effects.
